cookieConsent.title: openIndu Community Respects Your Privacy
cookieConsent.description: This site uses necessary browser storage to work properly and optional first-party analytics to improve your browsing experience. By selecting Accept All, you consent to analytics. By selecting Reject All, analytics remains disabled. Select Manage Cookies to choose your preference. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.
cookieConsent.cookiesLink: For more information, see About Cookies.
cookieConsent.manageDescription: Necessary storage supports core and security features. Analytics helps us understand anonymous page visits.

edgeComputing.description: Edge computing platform for industrial automation
edgeComputing.subtitle: A project direction for equipment connectivity, edge data processing, and distributed automation; capabilities depend on repository evidence
edgeComputing.realtimeDesc: Process data close to equipment; latency depends on tests in the target environment
edgeComputing.securityDesc: On-premise data processing keeps sensitive manufacturing data local
edgeComputing.connectDesc: Multi-protocol support: Modbus, EtherCAT, OPC-UA, CANopen
edgeComputing.perfDesc: A testable edge-computing path without unverified mission-critical control claims
edgeComputing.capabilitiesDesc: Everything you need for edge-based industrial automation
edgeComputing.useCase1Desc: Connect multiple edge nodes across production facilities with centralized management
edgeComputing.useCase2Desc: Process sensor data at the edge, aggregate to cloud for analytics and historical analysis
edgeComputing.useCase3Desc: Unified interface for multi-protocol devices: Modbus, EtherCAT, CANopen, OPC-UA
edgeComputing.useCase4Desc: Continue operating during connectivity loss, sync data when connection restored
edgeComputing.ctaDesc: Review the current code, documentation, license, and known limitations before evaluating it for your environment.
